zh.problem: 让人和 AI 智能体使用同一份可读的有限元模型，而不是在对话、临时求解脚本和结果文件之间反复转换。
zh.method: 用 Python 表达研究类型、网格、材料、载荷和求解步骤；以 FEniCSx、UFL 和 PETSc 执行数值计算，并将结果连接到参数化仿真、数据集和代理模型。

en.problem: Let people and AI agents share one readable finite-element model rather than repeatedly translating between chat, ad hoc solver scripts and result files.
en.method: Express studies, meshes, materials, loads and solution steps in Python; execute with FEniCSx, UFL and PETSc; connect recorded results to parameter campaigns, datasets and surrogate models.
en.evaluation: The August 2026 technical report demonstrates version 0.2.1 using a cantilever, inclusion-wave propagation and a C3D10H periodic porous cell. It is a software/case report, not an autonomous-agent success-rate benchmark or general industrial validation.

https://haoming-luo.github.io/agentfem/p.sourceTitle: AgentFEM: An AI-Native Open-Source Platform for Finite-Element Computing

zh.evaluation: 官方代码工具；这里没有单独的论文实验结果。

en.problem: Make mathematical operations reusable and checkable for research agents.
en.method: Provides typed mathematical primitives with explicit conditions that agents can find, compose and execute.
en.evaluation: An official software project; this entry does not provide a separate paper evaluation.

zh.problem: 规模化开展研究后，如何区分产物数量和结论质量？
zh.method: 以精简提示和并行研究循环组织任务，将可执行检查与科学判断分开。
zh.evaluation: 报告跨领域的 444 轮运行，并分析哪些失败仍需人类判断。

en.problem: How can scalable research distinguish output volume from the quality of its claims?
en.method: Orchestrates parallel research loops using compact prompts and separates executable checks from scientific judgment.
en.evaluation: Reports 444 cross-domain iterations and analyzes failures that still require human judgment.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24177.sourceTitle: Agon: An Autonomous Large-Scale Omnidisciplinary Research System Built on Prompt Economy

zh.problem: 现有自主研究系统到底验证了什么？
zh.method: 按系统、任务、产物和验证方式组织文献，区分生成研究材料与支撑科学结论。
zh.evaluation: 系统化综述；不是一个新智能体的性能报告。

en.problem: What do autonomous research systems actually verify?
en.method: Organizes systems, tasks, artifacts and verification practices, distinguishing generated research artifacts from supported claims.
en.evaluation: A systematization of prior work, rather than a performance report for a new agent.

https://haizhaoyang.github.io/research/a.sourceTitle: What's Missing in Autonomous Research? A Systematization of Systems, Benchmarks, and Verification

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03315.name: Why LLMs Aren't Scientists Yet

zh.problem: 端到端研究为何仍会在实现和判断环节失效？
zh.method: 回顾多智能体研究尝试，分析记忆丢失、实现偏移与研究判断问题。
zh.evaluation: 四个机器学习研究案例；结论是案例观察，不是通用能力排名。

en.problem: Why does end-to-end research still fail at implementation and judgment?
en.method: Examines multi-agent research attempts for memory loss, implementation drift and weak research judgment.
en.evaluation: Four machine-learning research cases; the conclusions are case observations, not a general capability ranking.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03315.sourceTitle: Why LLMs Aren't Scientists Yet: Lessons from Four Autonomous Research Attempts

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02824.name: Kosmos

zh.problem: 如何让长时间的数据分析和文献检索共同推进一个科学问题？
zh.method: 并行安排分析和检索智能体，用结构化世界模型共享中间发现并生成可追溯报告。
zh.evaluation: 展示代谢组、材料、神经科学和遗传学等七项发现，并报告科学家评估。

en.problem: How can prolonged data analysis and literature search advance one scientific question together?
en.method: Runs analysis and search agents in parallel, sharing intermediate findings through a structured world model and producing traceable reports.
en.evaluation: Presents seven discoveries across areas including metabolomics, materials, neuroscience and genetics, alongside scientist assessments.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02824.sourceTitle: Kosmos: An AI Scientist for Autonomous Discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09901.name: Orchestrating Scientists, Language, Code & Physics

zh.problem: 科学家的判断、语言推理、代码和物理模型如何协作？
zh.method: 讨论将这些能力编排到科学发现流程中的架构与挑战。
zh.evaluation: 观点与框架讨论；不应解读成一个统一系统已完成全部验证。

en.problem: How should scientists, language reasoning, code and physical models work together?
en.method: Discusses architectures and challenges for coordinating these capabilities across scientific discovery.
en.evaluation: A perspective and framework discussion; it does not establish full validation of one unified system.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09901.sourceTitle: Autonomous Agents for Scientific Discovery: Orchestrating Scientists, Language, Code, and Physics

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.14111.name: From AI for Science to Agentic Science

zh.problem: 科学 AI 怎样从单任务模型走向能规划和行动的系统？
zh.method: 梳理不同学科的智能体工作，比较任务流程、自主程度和工具使用。
zh.evaluation: 综述生命、化学与物理科学等研究方向，不提供统一排行榜。

en.problem: How is scientific AI moving from task-specific models to systems that plan and act?
en.method: Surveys scientific agents across disciplines, comparing workflows, autonomy and tool use.
en.evaluation: A survey spanning life, chemical and physical sciences, without a unified performance leaderboard.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.14111.sourceTitle: From AI for Science to Agentic Science: A Survey on Autonomous Scientific Discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.08066.name: The AI Scientist-v2

zh.problem: 能否减少人工模板，自动探索机器学习研究思路？
zh.method: 通过渐进式树搜索安排实验，并用视觉语言反馈检查图表，串联实验和论文写作。
zh.evaluation: 报告三个研讨会投稿实验，其中一个达到评审接受阈值；这不等于普遍具备科学发现能力。

en.problem: Can machine-learning research be explored with less dependence on human-written templates?
en.method: Uses progressive tree search for experiments and vision-language feedback for figures, connecting experimentation to paper writing.
en.evaluation: Reports three workshop submission experiments, one reaching the review acceptance threshold; this is not evidence of general scientific discovery capability.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.08066.sourceTitle: The AI Scientist-v2: Workshop-Level Automated Scientific Discovery via Agentic Tree Search

zh.problem: 不同智能体实验室能否积累并复用先前研究？
zh.method: 把生成的研究存入共享预印本文库，让后续研究检索并扩展已有结果。
zh.evaluation: 在 MATH-500 等推理研究任务中测试知识共享与累积改进。

en.problem: Can separate agent laboratories accumulate and reuse previous research?
en.method: Stores generated research in a shared preprint repository so later work can retrieve and extend earlier results.
en.evaluation: Tests shared research and cumulative improvement on reasoning research tasks including MATH-500.

zh.problem: 如何从一个研究目标形成更值得实验的生物医学假设？
zh.method: 多个智能体生成、批评和修订假设，通过竞争式评估逐步筛选研究提案。
zh.evaluation: 研究包含药物重定位等生物医学案例及实验检验；具体结论限于相应案例。

en.problem: How can a research goal become a biomedical hypothesis worth testing?
en.method: Agents generate, criticize and revise hypotheses, using tournament-style assessment to select proposals.
en.evaluation: Includes biomedical cases such as drug repurposing and experimental tests; findings are specific to those cases.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.04227.name: Agent Laboratory

zh.problem: 如何把研究者的初始想法转化成实验和报告？
zh.method: 将文献整理、实验执行和论文写作交给不同智能体，在阶段间接受用户反馈。
zh.evaluation: 使用机器学习实验与研究者反馈评估流程质量和实用性。

en.problem: How can a researcher's initial idea become experiments and a report?
en.method: Assigns literature review, experiment execution and writing to agents, incorporating user feedback between stages.
en.evaluation: Evaluates workflow quality and usefulness through machine-learning experiments and researcher feedback.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.04227.sourceTitle: Agent Laboratory: Using LLM Agents as Research Assistants

https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.14033.name: MLR-Copilot

zh.problem: 机器学习研究想法如何更可靠地落到可运行实验？
zh.method: 结合想法生成、原型代码检索、执行调试与人工反馈。
zh.evaluation: 在五项机器学习研究任务上评估实验生成能力。

en.problem: How can machine-learning ideas be translated into executable experiments?
en.method: Combines idea generation, retrieval of prototype code, execution, debugging and human feedback.
en.evaluation: Evaluates experiment-generation capabilities on five machine-learning research tasks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.14033.sourceTitle: MLR-Copilot: Autonomous Machine Learning Research based on Large Language Models Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.06292.name: The AI Scientist

zh.problem: 从研究想法到实验、图表和论文，哪些环节能被串联自动化？
zh.method: 使用语言模型迭代生成想法、改代码、运行实验、撰写论文并给出自动评审。
zh.evaluation: 在扩散模型、Transformer 与学习动力学方向展示流程；自动评审不是科学正确性的保证。

en.problem: Which steps from an idea to experiments, figures and a paper can be automated together?
en.method: Uses language models to iterate on ideas, modify code, run experiments, write papers and produce automated reviews.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates workflows in diffusion models, Transformers and learning dynamics; automated review does not guarantee scientific correctness.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.06292.sourceTitle: The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery

zh.problem: 如何在大量文献中快速组织一篇连贯的综述？
zh.method: 检索相关论文并形成提纲，平行撰写子章节，再整合与修订。
zh.evaluation: 论文评估综述生成质量和引用表现；产物是文献综述。

en.problem: How can a coherent survey be organized from a large literature collection?
en.method: Retrieves papers, builds an outline, drafts subsections in parallel, then integrates and revises them.
en.evaluation: Evaluates survey-generation quality and citation performance; the output is a literature survey.

https://openreview.net/forum?id=FExX8pMr.sourceTitle: AutoSurvey: Large Language Models Can Automatically Write Surveys

zh.problem: 科学问答怎样给出能回溯到原文的证据？
zh.method: 检索论文全文、筛选相关段落，再结合证据生成带引用的回答。
zh.evaluation: 使用 LitQA 等文献问答任务，并与人类回答进行比较。

en.problem: How can scientific question answering provide evidence traceable to source texts?
en.method: Retrieves paper text, selects relevant passages and synthesizes answers with citations.
en.evaluation: Uses literature question-answering tasks including LitQA and comparisons with human answers.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.07559.sourceTitle: PaperQA: Retrieval-Augmented Generative Agent for Scientific Research

zh.problem: AI 正在怎样改变科学研究的方法与组织方式？
zh.method: 从数据、模型和科学发现流程梳理人工智能的作用与局限。
zh.evaluation: 领域综述；不对应一个可直接运行的统一科学智能体。

en.problem: How is AI changing the methods and organization of scientific research?
en.method: Reviews AI's role and limitations across data, models and scientific discovery workflows.
en.evaluation: A field review, rather than a single executable scientific-agent system.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.sourceTitle: Scientific discovery in the age of artificial intelligence

zh.problem: 智能体能否从验证反馈中学会提出更好的假设？
zh.method: 生成器与判别器对抗协作，把执行结果转成后续可复用的假设检验技能。
zh.evaluation: 在科学假设任务中评估；改进主要发生在技能和推理流程层。

en.problem: Can agents learn to propose better hypotheses from verification feedback?
en.method: A generator and discriminator work adversarially, turning execution results into reusable hypothesis-testing skills.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on scientific hypothesis tasks; improvement primarily concerns skills and reasoning workflows.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25770.sourceTitle: HypoForge: A Self-Improving Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Hypothesis Generation and Testing via Scientific Skill Learning

zh.problem: 优化器能否继续优化帮助自己求解的程序？
zh.method: 递归叠加求解辅助程序与元优化层，用统一操作探索不同深度的优化结构。
zh.evaluation: 覆盖八类任务，包括数学与符号回归；部分任务缺少独立留出集，不能据此推断通用 RSI。

en.problem: Can an optimizer improve the programs that help it solve problems?
en.method: Recursively adds solver helpers and meta-optimization layers, exploring optimization depth with a shared operation.
en.evaluation: Covers eight task families, including mathematics and symbolic regression; some lack held-out splits, limiting claims about general RSI.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24735.sourceTitle: Meta$^n$: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth

zh.problem: 科学工具不断变化时，智能体如何扩充并保留能力？

zh.evaluation: 在包含 900 个任务的 OpenSciToolBench 中检验动态工具使用。

en.problem: How can an agent expand and retain capabilities as scientific tools change?
en.method: Organizes tools in a graph, retains skills and experience, and uses an online selection mechanism to acquire tools.
en.evaluation: Tests dynamic tool use on the 900-task OpenSciToolBench.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28692.sourceTitle: SciToolAgent-Evo: An Ontology-Aware Self-Evolving Agent for Open-World Scientific Tool Acquisition

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29182.name: Evidence-Informed Beliefs

zh.problem: 新证据能否改变智能体后续探索的方向？
zh.method: 检索先前发现，在上下文中更新信念，并兼顾信息增益与探索多样性。
zh.evaluation: 在五个领域评估发现过程；这是证据驱动的上下文更新。

en.problem: Can new evidence change the direction of an agent's later exploration?
en.method: Retrieves earlier discoveries to update contextual beliefs while balancing informative and diverse exploration.
en.evaluation: Evaluates discovery processes in five domains; adaptation comes from evidence-informed contextual updates.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29182.sourceTitle: Evidence-Informed LLM Beliefs for Continual Scientific Discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06473.name: MLEvolve

zh.problem: 怎样避免机器学习智能体反复尝试相同的低效方案？
zh.method: 用渐进式图搜索联系不同实验分支，并用回顾记忆指导下一轮策略。
zh.evaluation: 在 MLE-bench 与数学优化任务中评估。

en.problem: How can machine-learning agents avoid repeating ineffective experiments?
en.method: Links experimental branches through progressive graph search and uses retrospective memory to guide future strategies.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on MLE-bench and mathematical optimization tasks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06473.sourceTitle: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17406.name: EvoMaster

zh.problem: 如何让跨多轮研究积累的经验影响后续执行？
zh.method: 把执行、探索与演化组织成持续循环，保留可支持下一轮决策的证据。
zh.evaluation: 报告十个混合科学与计算基准上的结果。

en.problem: How can experience accumulated across research iterations influence later execution?
en.method: Connects execution, exploration and evolution in persistent loops, retaining evidence for later decisions.
en.evaluation: Reports results across ten mixed scientific and computational benchmarks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17406.sourceTitle: EvoMaster: A Foundational Evolving Agent Framework for Agentic Science at Scale

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.01658.name: CORAL

zh.problem: 并行科研智能体如何长期共享有用的发现？
zh.method: 让持续运行的智能体共享知识与记忆，在不同探索路径之间交换经验。
zh.evaluation: 在数学、算法与优化问题中检验协作效果。

en.problem: How can parallel research agents share useful findings over time?
en.method: Persistent agents share knowledge and memory, exchanging experience across exploration paths.
en.evaluation: Evaluates collaboration on mathematics, algorithmic and optimization problems.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.01658.sourceTitle: CORAL: Towards Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution for Open-Ended Discovery

zh.problem: 智能体能否同时改进任务程序和自己的改进程序？
zh.method: 将任务智能体与元智能体实现为可编辑代码，允许修改求解流程及元级更新逻辑。
zh.evaluation: 在多个计算任务中测试，并研究元级经验跨领域转移。

en.problem: Can an agent improve both its task program and the program that improves it?
en.method: Represents task and meta-agents as editable programs, allowing changes to both solving and meta-level update logic.
en.evaluation: Tests multiple computational tasks and studies transfer of meta-level experience across domains.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08127.name: EvoScientist

zh.problem: 研究构思与实验经验如何共同积累？
zh.method: 研究员、工程师与演化管理者分工，把构思和实验经验保存为不同记忆。
zh.evaluation: 评估研究想法质量与代码执行表现；记忆更新不等于基础模型权重更新。

en.problem: How can research ideas and experimental experience accumulate together?
en.method: A researcher, engineer and evolution manager retain separate memories for ideation and experiments.
en.evaluation: Evaluates idea quality and code execution; memory updates are distinct from foundation-model weight updates.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08127.sourceTitle: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01550.name: S1-NexusAgent

zh.problem: 复杂科学任务怎样在规划和实际执行之间保持连贯？
zh.method: 分层规划与代码执行形成双循环，结合工具调用与批评反馈蒸馏科学技能。
zh.evaluation: 在生物、化学和材料科学任务中评估。

en.problem: How can complex scientific tasks stay coherent from planning through execution?
en.method: Combines hierarchical planning and code execution with tool use and critique-based distillation of scientific skills.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on biology, chemistry and materials-science tasks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01550.sourceTitle: S1-NexusAgent: a Self-Evolving Agent Framework for Multidisciplinary Scientific Research

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.16175.name: TTT-Discover

zh.problem: 能否针对一个困难测试问题，边求解边训练模型？
zh.method: 利用该问题的验证反馈进行测试时强化学习，目标是找到更好的单问题解。
zh.evaluation: 涉及数学、算法、计算内核与单细胞去噪；不是跨任务终身记忆评估。

en.problem: Can a model be trained while solving a difficult test-time problem?
en.method: Uses task verification feedback for test-time reinforcement learning to find a better solution to one problem.
en.evaluation: Covers mathematics, algorithms, kernels and single-cell denoising; it does not evaluate lifelong retention across tasks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.16175.sourceTitle: Learning to Discover at Test Time

https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.13131.name: AlphaEvolve

zh.problem: 语言模型提出的程序能否经执行筛选而持续改进？
zh.method: 让语言模型生成候选代码，以可计算目标评价，再进行进化式搜索。
zh.evaluation: 展示数学与计算基础设施优化；基础语言模型在搜索中保持固定。

en.problem: Can model-proposed programs improve through repeated execution and selection?
en.method: Language models propose code candidates that are scored by executable objectives and selected through evolutionary search.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates mathematical and computing-infrastructure optimization with fixed underlying language models.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.13131.sourceTitle: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.22954.name: Darwin Gödel Machine

zh.problem: 代码智能体能否修改自身实现以提升任务表现？
zh.method: 生成并评测自身代码的变体，用开放式档案保留有用的智能体分支。
zh.evaluation: 在软件工程和编程基准中测试；对科学实验室的适用性尚未由这些结果建立。

en.problem: Can a coding agent modify its own implementation to improve task performance?
en.method: Generates and evaluates variants of its own code, retaining useful agent branches in an open-ended archive.
en.evaluation: Tested on software-engineering and coding benchmarks; these results do not establish applicability to scientific laboratories.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.22954.sourceTitle: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20318.name: AI4AI-Bench

zh.problem: 智能体写出的训练算法，能否让重新训练的模型变得更好？
zh.method: 允许智能体修改训练规则，用独立重训练和隐藏评估检验改动。
zh.evaluation: 覆盖十个训练算法代码库；衡量递归改进的前提条件，而非证明无限自我提升。

en.problem: Can an agent-written training algorithm improve a model trained from scratch?
en.method: Allows agents to modify training rules, testing them through independent retraining and hidden evaluation.
en.evaluation: Covers ten training-algorithm repositories; it measures a prerequisite for recursive improvement, not unbounded self-improvement.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20318.sourceTitle: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement

zh.problem: 如何对科学研究智能体进行任务级评测？
zh.method: 官方项目提供研究任务、运行说明和评测资源，供不同智能体接入比较。

en.evaluation: This is a commentary on the original Virtual Lab study, not an independent experimental replication.

https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/article.sourceTitle: Virtual lab of artificial intelligence agents accelerating nanobody design against SARS-CoV-2 variants

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.name: The Virtual Lab

zh.problem: 人类研究者能否和一组 AI 专家共同开展蛋白质研究？
zh.method: 通过团队和个人会议组织智能体讨论，再构建结合蛋白语言模型、结构预测与物理计算的流程。
zh.evaluation: 设计 92 个纳米抗体候选并进行实验测试；人类研究者参与指导和实验。

en.problem: Can a human researcher work with a team of AI specialists on protein research?
en.method: Uses team and individual meetings to organize agents and build a pipeline combining protein language models, structure prediction and physical computation.
en.evaluation: Designed 92 nanobody candidates for experimental testing, with human researchers providing guidance and laboratory work.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.sourceTitle: The Virtual Lab of AI agents designs new SARS-CoV-2 nanobodies

https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.21035.name: GenoMAS

zh.problem: 基因表达分析如何兼顾结构化流程和异常情况处理？
zh.method: 六个专业智能体以类型化消息协作，把分析计划分为可推进、修订或回退的步骤。
zh.evaluation: 在 GenoTEX 上评估预处理与基因识别，并考察混杂因素调整。

en.problem: How can gene-expression analysis combine structured workflows with flexible exception handling?
en.method: Six specialized agents communicate through typed messages, decomposing analysis into steps that can advance, revise or backtrack.
en.evaluation: Evaluates preprocessing and gene identification on GenoTEX, including adjustment for confounding factors.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.21035.sourceTitle: GenoMAS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Scientific Discovery via Code-Driven Gene Expression Analysis

https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.02004.name: STELLA

zh.problem: 生物医学智能体能否突破固定工具箱的限制？
zh.method: 积累可复用的推理模板，并自动发现、创建和整合新工具。
zh.evaluation: 在生物医学 HLE 与 LAB-Bench 任务中评估，并观察随试验次数增加的变化。

en.problem: Can a biomedical agent move beyond a fixed toolbox?
en.method: Accumulates reusable reasoning templates and automatically discovers, creates and integrates tools.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on biomedical HLE and LAB-Bench tasks, including changes as trial experience accumulates.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.02004.sourceTitle: STELLA: Self-Evolving LLM Agent for Biomedical Research

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13400.name: Robin

zh.problem: 文献、假设、实验和数据分析怎样形成连续研究循环？
zh.method: 让检索和分析智能体提出假设与实验计划，再根据实验结果更新后续研究。
zh.evaluation: 通过干性年龄相关性黄斑变性的候选治疗研究展示；实验发现不等于临床有效性。

en.problem: How can literature, hypotheses, experiments and data analysis form a continuous research loop?
en.method: Search and analysis agents propose hypotheses and experiments, then use results to update subsequent research.
en.evaluation: Demonstrated through candidate-treatment research for dry age-related macular degeneration; experimental findings do not establish clinical efficacy.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13400.sourceTitle: Robin: A multi-agent system for automating scientific discovery

https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/.name: Biomni

zh.problem: 一个通用智能体怎样跨多个生物医学子领域执行任务？
zh.method: 在统一环境中检索并组合专业工具、软件和数据库，用代码实现研究计划。
zh.evaluation: 论文与官方资料展示多类生物医学任务；工具覆盖面不等于所有任务均可靠完成。

en.problem: How can one general-purpose agent execute tasks across biomedical subfields?
en.method: Retrieves and composes specialized tools, software and databases in a unified environment, implementing research plans through code.
en.evaluation: The paper and official materials demonstrate varied biomedical tasks; broad tool coverage does not imply reliable completion of every task.

https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/.sourceTitle: Biomni: A General-Purpose Biomedical AI Agent

https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10970.name: TxAgent

zh.problem: 药物推理如何结合最新资料和患者具体条件？
zh.method: 通过多步工具调用整合药物、相互作用、禁忌和疾病证据，并迭代修订回答。
zh.evaluation: 在五个药物推理基准及个性化情景中评估；这是任务评测，不是临床试验。

en.problem: How can drug reasoning incorporate current evidence and patient-specific conditions?
en.method: Uses multi-step tool calls to combine evidence about drugs, interactions, contraindications and conditions, iteratively revising answers.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on five drug-reasoning benchmarks and personalized scenarios; these are task evaluations, not clinical trials.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10970.sourceTitle: TxAgent: An AI Agent for Therapeutic Reasoning Across a Universe of Tools

https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15692.name: DrugAgent

zh.problem: 药物发现中的机器学习思路如何变成领域正确的代码？
zh.method: 规划智能体制定方案，指导智能体补充领域知识并协助实现。
zh.evaluation: 三个药物发现编程案例，包括药物—靶标相互作用预测。

en.problem: How can machine-learning ideas for drug discovery become domain-appropriate code?
en.method: A planner proposes approaches while an instructor supplies domain knowledge and guides implementation.
en.evaluation: Three drug-discovery programming cases, including drug–target interaction prediction.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15692.sourceTitle: DrugAgent: Automating AI-aided Drug Discovery Programming through LLM Multi-Agent Collaboration

https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.06029.name: TourSynbio-Agent

zh.problem: 对话式蛋白质工程是否能在计算与湿实验中产生实际效果？
zh.method: 将蛋白质专用语言模型与多个专业预测和设计模型整合到智能体流程。
zh.evaluation: 三个计算案例和两个湿实验案例，包含酶选择性及催化效率优化。

en.problem: Can conversational protein engineering produce useful computational and wet-lab results?
en.method: Integrates a protein-specialized language model with dedicated prediction and design models in an agent workflow.
en.evaluation: Three computational cases and two wet-lab cases, including enzyme selectivity and catalytic-efficiency optimization.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.06029.sourceTitle: Validation of an LLM-based Multi-Agent Framework for Protein Engineering in Dry Lab and Wet Lab

https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full.name: AutoBA

zh.problem: 生物学研究者如何减少多组学分析中的软件配置与编程？
zh.method: 根据数据路径、数据描述和目标生成分析计划，安装工具、写代码并执行。
zh.evaluation: 评估多种常规组学任务的规划、代码生成和端到端执行；用户仍需提供输入与审查结果。

en.problem: How can biologists reduce software setup and programming in multi-omics analysis?
en.method: Uses a data path, description and goal to plan analyses, install tools, generate code and execute it.
en.evaluation: Evaluates planning, code generation and end-to-end execution across conventional omics tasks; users still supply inputs and review results.

https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full.sourceTitle: An AI Agent for Fully Automated Multi-Omic Analyses

https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.17631.name: BioDiscoveryAgent

zh.problem: 有限实验预算下，应优先测试哪些基因扰动？
zh.method: 利用生物知识、文献检索和已有实验结果提出下一批候选，并由批评智能体检查。
zh.evaluation: 在六个数据集上比较扰动选择，其中包含未公开数据，并研究组合扰动。

en.problem: Which genetic perturbations should be tested under a limited experimental budget?
en.method: Uses biological knowledge, literature retrieval and earlier results to propose candidates, with critique from another agent.
en.evaluation: Compares perturbation selection across six datasets, including unpublished data, and studies combinatorial perturbations.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.17631.sourceTitle: BioDiscoveryAgent: An AI Agent for Designing Genetic Perturbation Experiments

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-0.name: BioImage.IO Chatbot

zh.problem: 生物图像分析的文档、模型和工具如何更容易被使用？
zh.method: 结合社区维护的知识来源和工具接口，用自然语言提供有出处的分析帮助。
zh.evaluation: 展示图像分析问答与工具使用场景；依赖知识库内容和工具可用性。

en.problem: How can bioimage-analysis documentation, models and tools become easier to use?
en.method: Combines community-maintained knowledge sources and tool interfaces to provide grounded analysis assistance through natural language.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates image-analysis assistance and tool-use scenarios, depending on knowledge-base coverage and available tools.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-0.sourceTitle: BioImage.IO Chatbot: a community-driven AI assistant for integrative computational bioimaging

https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.15299.name: TourSynbio

zh.problem: 如何在一个语言模型中连接自然语言和蛋白质序列？
zh.method: 通过蛋白质与文本数据进行训练，并将专业模型接入统一对话式工程框架。
zh.evaluation: 使用 ProteinLMBench 及蛋白质工程案例，包括两个湿实验示例。

en.problem: How can one language model connect natural language with protein sequences?
en.method: Trains on protein and text data and connects specialized models through a unified conversational engineering framework.
en.evaluation: Uses ProteinLMBench and protein-engineering cases, including two wet-lab examples.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.15299.sourceTitle: TourSynbio: A Multi-Modal Large Model and Agent Framework to Bridge Text and Protein Sequences for Protein Engineering

https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.02483.name: MMedAgent

zh.problem: 多模态医学任务如何路由到合适的专业工具？
zh.method: 构造工具使用指令数据，对模型进行微调以学习工具选择与调用。
zh.evaluation: 覆盖六个工具、七项任务和五种模态，并测试加入新工具。

en.problem: How can multimodal medical tasks be routed to appropriate specialized tools?
en.method: Builds tool-use instruction data and fine-tunes a model to select and invoke tools.
en.evaluation: Covers six tools, seven tasks and five modalities, and tests the integration of new tools.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.02483.sourceTitle: MMedAgent: Learning to Use Medical Tools with Multi-modal Agent

https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.14777.name: ClinicalAgent

zh.problem: 临床试验相关预测怎样利用外部专门工具？
zh.method: 结合多智能体、任务分解和行动反馈，将语言推理连接到临床试验工具。
zh.evaluation: 主要评估临床试验结果预测；预测分数不等于临床效果。

en.problem: How can clinical-trial predictions use specialized external tools?
en.method: Combines multiple agents, task decomposition and action feedback to connect language reasoning with clinical-trial tools.
en.evaluation: Primarily evaluates clinical-trial outcome prediction; prediction scores are not evidence of clinical benefit.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.14777.sourceTitle: ClinicalAgent: Clinical Trial Multi-Agent System with Large Language Model-based Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02831.name: Empowering Biomedical Discovery

zh.problem: 生物医学 AI 科学家应怎样与研究者及实验平台协作？
zh.method: 提出结合专业模型、工具、结构化记忆和自我评估的协作研究愿景。
zh.evaluation: 观点文章，讨论虚拟细胞、表型与治疗等方向；不报告统一系统的全面验证。

en.problem: How should biomedical AI scientists collaborate with researchers and experimental platforms?
en.method: Proposes collaborative research systems combining specialized models, tools, structured memory and self-assessment.
en.evaluation: A perspective discussing areas such as virtual cells, phenotypes and therapeutics, without comprehensive validation of a unified system.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02831.sourceTitle: Empowering Biomedical Discovery with AI Agents

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-0.name: Omega

zh.problem: 研究者能否在图像查看器里用对话完成图像分析？
zh.method: 作为 napari 插件读取图像与界面状态，生成执行 Python，并根据反馈修正代码。
zh.evaluation: 展示分割、计数、定量和去噪等交互任务。

en.problem: Can researchers perform image analysis conversationally inside an image viewer?
en.method: A napari plugin reads images and viewer state, generates and executes Python, and corrects code using feedback.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates interactive segmentation, counting, quantification and denoising tasks.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-0.sourceTitle: Omega — harnessing the power of large language models for bioimage analysis

https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/.name: CellAgent

zh.problem: 单细胞分析能否减少人工选工具和调参数的负担？
zh.method: 规划者、执行者和评价者分层协作，迭代检查并优化分析流程。
zh.evaluation: 在覆盖多种组织和细胞类型的单细胞数据上评估。

en.problem: Can single-cell analysis reduce manual tool selection and parameter tuning?
en.method: A planner, executor and evaluator coordinate hierarchically to check and optimize analysis workflows.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on single-cell data spanning multiple tissues and cell types.

https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/.sourceTitle: CellAgent: An LLM-driven Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Single-cell Data Analysis

https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/.name: BioInformatics Agent · BIA

zh.problem: 自然语言能否驱动从数据读取到分析报告的生信工作流？
zh.method: 读取原始数据与元数据、查询数据库、设计工作流、生成代码并总结结果。
zh.evaluation: 以单细胞 RNA 测序为主要案例，并分析执行失败与潜在改进。

en.problem: Can natural language drive a bioinformatics workflow from data access to a report?
en.method: Reads data and metadata, queries databases, designs workflows, generates code and summarizes results.
en.evaluation: Focuses on single-cell RNA sequencing and analyzes execution failures and possible improvements.

https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/.sourceTitle: BioInformatics Agent (BIA): Unleashing the Power of Large Language Models to Reshape Bioinformatics Workflow

https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.02957.name: Agent Hospital

zh.problem: 模拟诊疗经验能否改善医生智能体的问答表现？
zh.method: 在由患者、护士和医生智能体构成的医院模拟中积累诊疗经验并演化医生策略。
zh.evaluation: 在模拟运行后测试 MedQA；模拟和考试成绩不能替代真实临床验证。

en.problem: Can simulated treatment experience improve a doctor agent's question-answering performance?
en.method: Accumulates experience in a hospital simulation of patient, nurse and doctor agents, evolving the doctor agents' strategies.
en.evaluation: Tests MedQA after simulation; simulated experience and exam scores do not replace real clinical validation.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.02957.sourceTitle: Agent Hospital: A Simulacrum of Hospital with Evolvable Medical Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.18021.name: CRISPR-GPT

zh.problem: 非专业研究者怎样组织复杂的基因编辑实验设计？
zh.method: 通过领域知识和专业工具支持实验设计中的选择、规划与验证方案整理。
zh.evaluation: 论文展示实际用例；这里提供高层研究解读，具体实验有效性以原论文为准。

en.problem: How can non-specialists organize complex gene-editing experiment design?
en.method: Uses domain knowledge and specialized tools to support choices, planning and validation design within experiments.
en.evaluation: The paper demonstrates a practical use case; these high-level notes defer experimental validity to the original study.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.18021.sourceTitle: CRISPR-GPT for Agentic Automation of Gene-editing Experiments

https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04268.name: ProtAgents

zh.problem: 蛋白质设计怎样同时调用知识、机器学习和物理模拟？
zh.method: 不同专业智能体动态协作，完成知识检索、结构分析、模拟和结果解释。
zh.evaluation: 展示蛋白质设计与机械性质分析，包括基于物理的振动特性计算。

en.problem: How can protein design combine knowledge, machine learning and physical simulation?
en.method: Specialized agents collaborate dynamically on retrieval, structural analysis, simulation and interpretation.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates protein design and mechanical-property analysis, including physics-based vibrational calculations.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04268.sourceTitle: ProtAgents: Protein discovery via large language model multi-agent collaborations combining physics and machine learning

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.name: PathChat

zh.problem: 病理图像和自然语言问题如何共同驱动医学助理？
zh.method: 将病理视觉编码器与语言模型结合，通过多模态指令数据训练。
zh.evaluation: 用诊断选择题及病理学专家评估的开放问答检验；不是自主临床诊断系统的试验。

en.problem: How can pathology images and natural-language questions jointly inform a medical assistant?
en.method: Combines a pathology vision encoder with a language model and trains it on multimodal instructions.
en.evaluation: Uses diagnostic multiple-choice questions and pathologist-assessed open responses; it is not a trial of autonomous clinical diagnosis.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-0.sourceTitle: A multimodal generative AI copilot for human pathology

https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.06155.name: MolRL-MGPT

zh.problem: 分子生成如何兼顾目标性质与候选多样性？
zh.method: 多个 GPT 生成智能体通过强化学习协作，向不同方向搜索候选分子。
zh.evaluation: 在 GuacaMol 和特定蛋白靶标的计算设计任务中评估。

en.problem: How can molecular generation balance target properties and candidate diversity?
en.method: Multiple GPT-based generation agents cooperate through reinforcement learning to explore different molecular candidates.
en.evaluation: Evaluated on GuacaMol and computational design tasks for specific protein targets.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.06155.sourceTitle: De novo Drug Design using Reinforcement Learning with Multiple GPT Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.10537.name: MedAgents

zh.problem: 无需额外训练，多个医学专家角色能否改善推理？
zh.method: 召集专业角色独立分析、汇总讨论，再通过多轮协商形成答案。
zh.evaluation: 在九个医学问答数据集或子任务中测试零样本表现。

en.problem: Can multiple medical expert roles improve reasoning without additional training?
en.method: Expert roles analyze independently, summarize findings and discuss them over multiple rounds before answering.
en.evaluation: Tests zero-shot performance on nine medical QA datasets or subtasks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.10537.sourceTitle: MedAgents: Large Language Models as Collaborators for Zero-shot Medical Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.03549.name: Zhongjing

zh.problem: 中文医学模型怎样学会主动追问与多轮理解？
zh.method: 结合持续预训练、真实医患对话的监督微调及专家反馈强化学习。
zh.evaluation: 使用多轮医疗对话和人工评价检验问答能力；不是临床疗效试验。

en.problem: How can a Chinese medical model learn proactive questions and multi-turn understanding?
en.method: Combines continued pretraining, supervised learning from real medical dialogues and reinforcement learning from expert feedback.
en.evaluation: Uses multi-turn medical dialogue and human evaluation to test QA capabilities, not clinical efficacy.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.03549.sourceTitle: Zhongjing: Enhancing the Chinese Medical Capabilities of Large Language Model through Expert Feedback and Real-world Multi-turn Dialogue

zh.problem: 疫情模型如何表示人们根据环境改变行为的过程？
zh.method: 在个体级传播模拟中，让语言模型为个体生成隔离等行为决策。
zh.evaluation: 观察多波传播和曲线变化等模拟现象；不等于已经验证真实疫情预测能力。

en.problem: How can epidemic models represent people changing behavior in response to their surroundings?
en.method: Uses language models for individual decisions, such as isolation, within an agent-based epidemic simulation.
en.evaluation: Examines simulated waves and curve changes; it does not establish validated real-world epidemic forecasting.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.15075.name: HuatuoGPT

zh.problem: 医学咨询模型如何同时获得流畅表达和医生式回答能力？
zh.method: 将蒸馏对话与真实医生数据结合微调，再通过反馈奖励进行对齐。
zh.evaluation: 通过人工、模型评审和医学基准评估咨询回答。

en.problem: How can a consultation model combine fluent explanations with doctor-like responses?
en.method: Combines distilled conversations and real doctor data for fine-tuning, followed by feedback-based reward alignment.
en.evaluation: Evaluates consultation responses with human assessments, model judging and medical benchmarks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.15075.sourceTitle: HuatuoGPT, towards Taming Language Model to Be a Doctor

https://www.nature.com/articles/s42256-0.name: Self-Driving Labs in Deep Space

zh.problem: 深空生物研究怎样应对通信、资源和人工操作限制？
zh.method: 总结 NASA 研讨会建议，讨论 AI、自动实验、预测模型和数据管理的结合。
zh.evaluation: 路线与综述文章；不是已在深空运行的 LLM 实验室报告。

en.problem: How can deep-space biology address limits on communication, resources and manual operation?
en.method: Synthesizes NASA workshop recommendations on AI, automated experiments, predictive models and data management.
en.evaluation: A roadmap and review, not a report of an LLM laboratory already operating in deep space.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s42256-0.sourceTitle: Biological research and self-driving labs in deep space supported by artificial intelligence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.07738.name: ResearchAgent

zh.problem: 如何从已有文献中提出并不断修订研究想法？
zh.method: 从核心论文、学术图谱与概念知识库扩展证据，由评审智能体迭代反馈。
zh.evaluation: 使用跨学科论文进行人类与模型评价；重点是想法质量而非执行实验。

en.problem: How can research ideas be proposed and repeatedly refined from existing literature?
en.method: Expands from a seed paper through academic graphs and concept knowledge, iterating with feedback from reviewing agents.
en.evaluation: Uses human and model assessments across disciplines, focusing on idea quality rather than executed experiments.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.07738.sourceTitle: ResearchAgent: Iterative Research Idea Generation over Scientific Literature with Large Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.03220.name: Alympics

zh.problem: 语言智能体能否用于研究策略互动与博弈？
zh.method: 构建受控博弈模拟，让不同智能体在多轮资源竞争中形成策略。
zh.evaluation: 以水资源分配挑战为案例，并有人类对策略行为的评估。

en.problem: Can language agents help study strategic interaction and games?
en.method: Builds controlled game simulations in which agents develop strategies through repeated competition for resources.
en.evaluation: Uses a water-allocation challenge and human assessments of strategic behavior.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.03220.sourceTitle: ALYMPICS: LLM Agents Meet Game Theory -- Exploring Strategic Decision-Making with AI Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.02172.name: Lyfe Agents

zh.problem: 如何以较低计算成本实现实时、连贯的虚拟社会互动？
zh.method: 结合分层行动、异步自我监控，以及优先保留重要信息的摘要记忆。
zh.evaluation: 在 LyfeGame 的多智能体情景中评估主动性、社交行为与运行成本。

en.problem: How can coherent virtual social interaction run in real time at lower cost?
en.method: Combines hierarchical actions, asynchronous self-monitoring and summary memory that prioritizes important information.
en.evaluation: Evaluates initiative, social behavior and operating cost in multi-agent LyfeGame scenarios.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.02172.sourceTitle: Lyfe Agents: Generative agents for low-cost real-time social interactions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.11667.name: SOTOPIA

zh.problem: 怎样评估智能体在开放社交场景中的目标达成能力？
zh.method: 让智能体扮演不同角色进行合作、竞争和交流，用多维规则评估互动。
zh.evaluation: 比较语言模型与人类，并构建更困难的 SOTOPIA-hard 场景。

en.problem: How can agents' goal achievement be evaluated in open-ended social situations?
en.method: Agents role-play cooperation, competition and communication, assessed through multidimensional interaction criteria.
en.evaluation: Compares language models and humans and introduces harder SOTOPIA-hard scenarios.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.11667.sourceTitle: SOTOPIA: Interactive Evaluation for Social Intelligence in Language Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.10436.name: EconAgent

zh.problem: 宏观经济模拟怎样表示具有不同经历和偏好的个体？
zh.method: 用语言模型生成劳动和消费决策，通过感知和记忆纳入个人及市场历史。
zh.evaluation: 将模拟产生的经济现象与规则或学习型智能体比较；不是现实政策预测验证。

en.problem: How can macroeconomic simulations represent individuals with different experiences and preferences?
en.method: Uses language models for work and consumption decisions, incorporating individual and market history through perception and memory.
en.evaluation: Compares simulated economic phenomena with rule-based or learned agents, rather than validating real policy forecasts.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.10436.sourceTitle: EconAgent: Large Language Model-Empowered Agents for Simulating Macroeconomic Activities

https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.02124.name: MachineSoM

zh.problem: 个性与讨论方式会怎样影响智能体群体协作？
zh.method: 组合不同性格与辩论、反思模式，构建四类智能体社会。
zh.evaluation: 在三个基准上比较表现和成本，并分析从众及共识等现象。

en.problem: How do traits and discussion styles affect agent collaboration?
en.method: Combines different traits with debate or reflection to construct four types of agent society.
en.evaluation: Compares performance and cost on three benchmarks and analyzes conformity and consensus.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.02124.sourceTitle: Exploring Collaboration Mechanisms for LLM Agents: A Social Psychology View

https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.14984.name: S³

zh.problem: 社交网络中的情绪、态度和信息传播如何被模拟？
zh.method: 让语言模型智能体感知信息环境并生成情绪、态度与互动行为。
zh.evaluation: 用真实社交网络数据评估个体与群体两个层面的模拟。

en.problem: How can emotions, attitudes and information spread be simulated in social networks?
en.method: Language agents perceive an information environment and generate emotional, attitudinal and interaction behavior.
en.evaluation: Uses real social-network data to evaluate simulations at individual and population levels.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.14984.sourceTitle: S$^3$: Social-network Simulation System with Large Language Model-Empowered Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07871.name: SocialAI School

zh.problem: 人工智能怎样学习参与社会文化所需的认知能力？
zh.method: 根据发展心理学构建可配置、程序生成的社交学习环境。
zh.evaluation: 通过强化学习智能体和语言模型的实验展示环境用途。

en.problem: How can AI learn the cognitive abilities needed to participate in social culture?
en.method: Builds configurable, procedurally generated social-learning environments informed by developmental psychology.
en.evaluation: Demonstrates the environments through experiments with reinforcement-learning agents and language models.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07871.sourceTitle: The SocialAI School: Insights from Developmental Psychology Towards Artificial Socio-Cultural Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.15810.name: Conversational Agents & Mental Well-Being

zh.problem: 使用大模型陪伴应用的人感受到哪些帮助与困难？
zh.method: 对 Replika 相关社区讨论进行定性分析，归纳使用体验与问题。
zh.evaluation: 分析 120 个帖子和 2,917 条评论；这是用户体验研究，不是疗效试验。

en.problem: What benefits and difficulties do users report from language-model companion apps?
en.method: Qualitatively analyzes community discussions about Replika to identify experiences and problems.
en.evaluation: Analyzes 120 posts and 2,917 comments; it is a user-experience study, not an efficacy trial.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.15810.sourceTitle: Understanding the Benefits and Challenges of Using Large Language Model-based Conversational Agents for Mental Well-being Support

https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03442.name: Generative Agents

zh.problem: 智能体如何在虚拟小镇中形成可信的日常和社会行为？
zh.method: 记录经历、检索记忆、形成高层反思，再据此规划行动和互动。
zh.evaluation: 在 25 个智能体的小镇模拟中评估行为可信度，并消融记忆、规划和反思组件。

en.problem: How can agents develop believable daily and social behavior in a virtual town?
en.method: Records experiences, retrieves memories and forms higher-level reflections to plan actions and interactions.
en.evaluation: Evaluates behavioral believability in a 25-agent town and ablates memory, planning and reflection components.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03442.sourceTitle: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior

https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.07543.name: Homo Silicus

zh.problem: 语言模型能否作为经济实验中的模拟参与者？
zh.method: 为模型赋予禀赋、信息和偏好，在经典实验情景中观察其选择。
zh.evaluation: 比较模拟与既有经济实验的定性结果，同时讨论使用模拟人的概念限制。

en.problem: Can language models act as simulated participants in economic experiments?
en.method: Assigns endowments, information and preferences to models, then observes choices in established experimental scenarios.
en.evaluation: Compares qualitative outcomes with prior economic experiments and discusses conceptual limits of simulated participants.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.07543.sourceTitle: Large Language Models as Simulated Economic Agents: What Can We Learn from Homo Silicus?
